review_candidates.title: Planner and Document Controller
review_candidates.location: Cape Town, Western Cape, South Africa
review_candidates.description: Planner and Document Controller Location: Green Point, Cape Town, Reporting to: Project Controls Manager Employment type: Full time / Permanent Anticipated start: Early 2027 About us Founded in 2005, Phelan Green Group (PGG) is a globally recognised renewable energy company headquartered in Cape Town, South Africa. Wholly owned by the Irish Phelan family, PGG operates across seven countries and four continents, delivering integrated sustainable-energy solutions spanning solar PV, green hydrogen and its derivatives, and battery energy storage systems. PGG has invested more than R4 billion in South Africa and commissioned over 500 MWp of solar PV capacity worldwide. In parallel, the Phelan family has assembled a strategic land portfolio of more than 30,000 hectares, supporting the development of large-scale renewable-energy and green-fuels projects. Over the past four years, PGG has expanded its focus into green hydrogen and downstream fuels, with particular emphasis on electro-sustainable aviation fuel (eSAF). Its projects are being developed to meet the requirements for Renewable Fuels of Non-Biological Origin (RFNBO) in the European Union and the United Kingdom, positioning the Group at the forefront of decarbonising hard-to-abate sectors. PGG’s flagship eSAF project will be developed on a 73-hectare site within the Group’s fully owned, 6,000-hectare Hopefield Hydrogen Park in the Western Cape, South Africa. At full capacity, the facility is planned to produce 140,000 tonnes of eSAF annually, supported by more than 1.5 GW of dedicated renewable-energy capacity. The project has reached Final Investment Decision and is now poised for construction of Phase 1, which is scheduled to commence in September 2026, targeting annual production of 35,000 tonnes of eSAF and requiring more than 600 MW of renewable power. Led by an experienced executive team, PGG’s core objective is to deliver globally competitive, low-cost green-energy solutions. As the world accelerates its transition towards decarbonisation, the Group remains focused on developing scalable, commercially viable projects that create lasting value and help build a more sustainable energy future. About the role The Planner and Document Controller keeps the construction programme current and the project's documents controlled, traceable and easy to find. The role supports the project team in delivering on time by tracking progress against the baseline programme. It also makes sure every drawing, specification and transmittal is the correct, approved revision. Key accountabilities Key responsibilities: Planning Maintain and update the project programme (Primavera P6 or MS Project) against the approved baseline. Collect weekly progress data from site teams, subcontractors and suppliers, and record actual start and finish dates. Track critical path activities and flag slippage, delays and look-ahead risks to the Project Manager. Prepare two- and four-week look-ahead schedules for site coordination meetings. Compile weekly and monthly progress reports, including progress curves and milestone status. Track procurement and delivery dates for long-lead equipment and materials. Support the preparation of extension-of-time and delay records with accurate programme evidence. Attend progress meetings and record actions that affect the programme. Key responsibilities: Document control Register, number, file and distribute all project documents according to the project document control procedure. Maintain the master document register, drawing register and revision history. Issue and log transmittals to clients, consultants, subcontractors and authorities, and track responses. Make sure only current, approved revisions are in use on site, and withdraw superseded documents. Manage the review and approval cycle for technical submittals, including due dates and reminders. Administer the electronic document management system and user access. Log and track requests for information (RFIs), site instructions, non-conformance reports and correspondence. Compile handover and as-built documentation packs at project close-out. Support internal and external audits by retrieving records quickly and accurately. Qualifications and experience Required Diploma or degree in construction management, quantity surveying, civil engineering, project management or a related field. 3 to 6 years' experience in planning, document control or project administration on construction or engineering projects. Working knowledge of Primavera P6 or MS Project. Advanced Microsoft Excel skills. Valid driver's licence and own transport for site visits. Advantageous Experience on renewable energy, utility-scale solar PV, BESS or other EPC projects. Experience with an electronic document management system such as Aconex, Procore or SharePoint. A recognised planning or document control short course. Skills and competencies High attention to detail and accuracy in records and revisions. Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage many documents and deadlines at once. Clear written and verbal communication with site teams, engineers and clients. Ability to read and interpret construction drawings and programmes. Analytical thinking: spots trends and risks in progress data. Discretion when handling confidential commercial and contractual documents. Willingness to learn and take direction from senior project staff.

MÔ TẢ CÔNG VIỆC Cùng các Team Leader các hệ hoàn thiện danh mục bản vẽ , theo dõi và triển khai bản vẽ theo thứ tự đã thống nhất với các Team. Vẽ bản vẽ thi công (Shop Drawing) theo yêu cầu từ các Team Leader các hệ theo tiến độ và kế hoạch của từng Team. Phối hợp trực tiếp với các kỹ sư hệ để hiểu rõ cấu hình, công việc cần vẽ, yêu cầu cuối cùng của từng bản vẽ cần thiết để thành sản phẩm có thể thi công hoặc trình sang CDT. Làm một số công việc khác khi được cấp trên giao. 2. YÊU CẦU CÔNG VIỆC Bằng cấp & Chứng chỉ Yêu cầu thành thạo Autocad 2D mức độ cao, triển khai được bản vẽ 3D khi có yêu cầu; có chứng chỉ thiết kế Autocad liên quan. Kiến thức & Kinh nghiệm Có kinh nghiệm đã từng vẽ bản vẽ các hệ Điện, điện nhẹ, điều hoà chiller, các đường ống nước ít nhất từ 2 dự án trở lên. Có kinh nghiệm tập hợp bản vẽ các hệ thành 1 bản vẽ tổng thể (Combine) từ 2 dự án trở lên. Có khả năng đọc hiểu về Layout các bản vẽ Điện/Điện nhẹ/ Điều hoà thông gió/ Đường ống nước điều hoà (là một lợi thế) Có khả năng sắp xếp bản vẽ khoa học và logic. Đã từng thi công MEP cho dự án Data Center Kỹ năng và Phẩm chất Có khả năng chịu được áp lực cao trong công tác thi công dự án. Có khả năng giao tiếp tốt, đọc hiểu Tiếng Anh. Có khả năng quản lý Ban chỉ huy (BCH) và làm việc độc lập tốt. Có khả năng đánh giá rủi ro về tiến độ thi công MEP, khả năng đề xuất điều chỉnh/bổ sung nhân sự. Có khả năng lập kế hoạch, bố trí nhân sự và triển khai kế hoạch thực hiện. Có khả năng lập báo cáo với Chủ đầu tư/công ty tốt. Có tinh thần cầu thị trong công việc. 3. QUYỀN LỢI Lương tháng thứ 13, thưởng hiệu quả kinh doanh theo quy định và theo kết quả kinh doanh của Công ty (Gói thu nhập năm 14-16 tháng/năm) Được đào tạo chuyên sâu về tuyển dụng IT, kỹ năng sourcing và Employer Branding. Môi trường làm việc với nhiều cơ hội phát triển. Review lương hàng năm 12 ngày phép năm + 1 ngày nghỉ sinh nhật + ngày nghỉ theo thâm niên Chế độ thăm hỏi, hiếu hỷ, ốm đau dành cho CBNV, vợ chồng con cái, tứ thân phụ mẫu Quỹ khuyến học dành cho con cái CBNV có thành tích trong học tập Chế độ bảo hiểm xã hội đầy đủ theo quy định của Luật. Gói bảo hiểm chăm sóc sức khỏe toàn diện cho CBNV Khám sức khỏe định kỳ hàng năm Tham gia các sự kiện nội bộ, Teambuilding, Noel, Year End Party, Du lịch hàng năm Nhiều chế độ đãi ngộ khác

Team members join a multidisciplinary environment that values technical excellence, collaboration, and long-term impact on communities and industries. Role Description: The Lead Wet Utility Design Engineer is a full-time, on-site role based in Qesm El Maadi. This role is responsible for leading the design and development of wet utility systems, including water supply, wastewater, and stormwater networks for infrastructure and industrial projects. Day-to-day tasks include preparing and reviewing design calculations, drawings, and technical specifications, coordinating with multidisciplinary engineering and project management teams, and ensuring compliance with relevant codes, standards, and client requirements. The Lead Wet Utility Design Engineer will oversee design quality, provide technical guidance to junior engineers and designers, and support site teams with design clarifications and modifications. The role also involves participating in design reviews, assisting in proposal preparation, and contributing to continuous improvement of design processes and tools. Professional background in Mechanical Engineering and/or Electrical Engineering applied to utility and infrastructure projects. Proficiency in Computer-Aided Design (CAD) tools and related design software for utility layout and modeling. Experience in Product Design or system component design related to pumps, piping, valves, and associated equipment. Bachelor’s degree or higher in Civil Engineering, Environmental Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a closely related field. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and documentation skills, with attention to detail and design accuracy. Effective communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across multidisciplinary teams and mentor junior staff. Ability to work on-site in Qesm El Maadi, manage multiple projects, and meet deadlines in a dynamic environment.

review_candidates.location: Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
review_candidates.description: Job Summary: We are seeking a highly skilled Infrastructure Technical Coordinator to join our Engineering team in Abu Dhabi. The successful candidate will be responsible for coordinating technical submissions, design documentation, authority approvals, and engineering activities to ensure the successful delivery of infrastructure projects. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in Abu Dhabi infrastructure contracting projects and a strong understanding of local authority requirements and approval processes. Key Responsibilities: Coordinate all technical submissions, including shop drawings, material submittals, RFIs, method statements, and engineering documentation. Review Issued for Construction (IFC) drawings and shop drawings to identify design discrepancies, technical issues, and constructability concerns. Coordinate with consultants, clients, subcontractors, and internal engineering teams to ensure timely review and approval of technical documents. Liaise with Abu Dhabi authorities to obtain required technical approvals and ensure compliance with applicable regulations and standards. Monitor the status of technical submissions and authority approvals to support project schedules and milestones. Coordinate design changes and ensure all approved revisions are communicated to project teams. Ensure all engineering documentation complies with project specifications, contractual requirements, and quality standards. Support project teams in resolving technical queries and coordinating engineering solutions. Maintain accurate records of technical submissions, approvals, and project documentation. Collaborate with project managers and site teams to ensure smooth project execution and timely delivery. Required Qualifications: Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering or a related Engineering discipline. Minimum 5 years of experience in infrastructure contracting projects within Abu Dhabi . Experience working with leading infrastructure contractors in the UAE is highly preferred. Required Skills & Experience Strong knowledge of Abu Dhabi authorities' requirements, submission procedures, and approval processes, including DMT, ADQCC, ADM, ITC, ADDC, TAQA, e& (Etisalat), du, and other relevant authorities. Proven experience coordinating technical submissions, shop drawings, material submittals, RFIs, method statements, and authority approvals. Ability to review IFC drawings and shop drawings, identify design clashes, and coordinate technical resolutions. Strong understanding of infrastructure disciplines, including: Roads, Utilities, Stormwater drainage, Irrigation, Street lighting, Landscaping Proficiency in AutoCAD and Microsoft Office applications. Experience with Civil 3D is an advantage. Excellent technical coordination and document management skills. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills. Excellent analytical, organizational, and problem-solving abilities. Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively under tight project deadlines. Valid UAE driving license is preferred. Preferred Candidate Profile Currently based in the UAE. Experience delivering infrastructure projects in Abu Dhabi. Familiarity with local authority approval systems and engineering standards. Strong attention to detail with a proactive and solution-oriented approach. Ability to work collaboratively within multidisciplinary project teams.
